findings: THE PUNCHLINE IS MEASURABLE AFTER ALL, and the judge said no regex would find it. Operationalised as CLOSING STING on the final sentence of a line: (b) a short (<=14w) closing sentence opening with Which/That is/And that/Nobody/No one, or (c) a trailing `, which/and that` clause or a `which is how/why/what/the` recast. Dialogue: ours 43.50 per 10k vs Morrowind 1.63 = 26.6x. Books 2.45 vs 0.05 = 45x. Journal 35.91 vs 6.06 = 5.9x. This is a bigger separator than `eleven` ever was.

AND THE HONEST HALF: the EPIGRAM-ECHO (short closing sentence repeating a content word from an earlier sentence — "That is not a mistake. A mistake happens once.") is at PARITY. Ours 27.68 per 10k vs Morrowind 23.76 = 1.16x in dialogue; books 2.12 vs 2.69 = 0.79x (they use it MORE). Morrowind writes epigrams too. What it does not do is close on a subordinate clause promoted to a recast. So the fix is NOT "stop being witty" — it is "stop appending an interpretive clause to the fact".

BIMODALITY CONFIRMED AND LOCATED, per dialogue file (words, sting/10k, q/10k, ex/10k): greetings.json 20185 / 82.2 / 49.5 / 34.7 (exclamations OVERSHOOT Morrowind's 21.25 by 1.6x); greetings/00-priority-classes.json 496 / 40.3 / 80.6 / 40.3 (1.9x overshoot); every topics/*.json file 0.0 exclamations and 0.0-8.7 questions. The seam is exactly greetings-vs-topics: the generator was swept, the topic files were not.

PRE-REGISTERED, BEFORE ANY LINE WAS REWRITTEN — THE EARNED-STING RULE. An info may close on a reversal, wry qualifier or epigram only if BOTH: (a) the speaker has a personal stake the player has worked for, operationalised as the info carrying a disposition gate (`d` present); AND (b) it is the ONLY such info in its topic. Everything else closes flat: the final sentence states a fact, gives a direction, names a price, or asks the player something. This is auditable from the JSON without reading the prose — 55-utility.json has 5 d-gated infos of 102, so at most 5 of its 34 topics may keep a sting; 50-factions.json has 33 of 106 across 41 topics.

A BAR DERIVED FROM THE CORPUS IT JUDGES CANNOT SAY THE CORPUS IS WRONG. My first calibrator set caps at the 90th percentile of our own files and produced a sting ceiling of 69.65 per 10k against a reference of 2.00 — 35x the thing it measured, red on nothing. Every bar is now a fixed multiple of the measured reference (3x for caps, 0.25x for floors). Recorded because the percentile version LOOKED rigorous and was vacuous.

THE UNDERSHOOT GUARD. "This file has no exclamation marks" is evidence only when the file is long enough for the reference rate to predict some. A bar's floor half is skipped unless target*words/1e4 >= 2. Without it the check flags every 400-word file for the absence of a thing that would not be there anyway.

MY OWN CLEAN CONTROL FAILED FIRST TIME AND THAT IS THE POINT. The self-test's negative control was one flat line repeated 40 times; the line carried one exclamation mark, so at 40 copies the fixture ran at 370 exclamations per 10k and tripped the OVERSHOOT half of the band it existed to pass. A control has to be a distribution, not a sample. Replaced with 26 varied flat service lines.

TWO FALSE POSITIVES IN MY OWN GATE, BOTH POINTING THE SAME WRONG WAY, both caught by reading its output against the corpus. THE MASKER DELIBERATELY CONTAINS NO LIST OF SETTING NAMES, and that is the design decision that matters. An enumerated table would be written by me, and I know our vocabulary far better than the reference's — so it would mask OUR names more thoroughly and convert a leak that favours the judge into one that favours us, which is worse. The masker infers proper nouns from capitalisation outside sentence-initial position, plus capitalised runs, plus each side's own corpus-wide vocabulary. Its only lexicon is English FUNCTION words, which is identical for both corpora and so cannot tilt.

QUESTION (a closing sentence that reuses a word and ends in ?) ours 1.03 vs 4.42 = 0.23x — MORROWIND DOES THIS FOUR TIMES MORE THAN WE DO, and it is exactly what this round was told to add. A FLATTENING PASS MAKES THE CLOSING-DIRECTION TELL WORSE UNLESS SOMEONE IS WATCHING IT, AND I DID IT TO MYSELF IN THE SAME SESSION I FOUND IT. MY OWN PROBE RETURNED ALL ZEROS FIRST AND I NEARLY BELIEVED THE CORPUS. ourText() yields {id,file,text} records, not strings; words(d) on the object scored "[object Object]" and every class came back 0.00 per 10k with a dialogue word count of 6,322 against the gate's 67,677. The tell was the word count, not the zeros — a probe reporting nothing found looks the same as a probe measuring nothing. Check the denominator before believing the numerator.

THE EARNED-STING RULE, in its final form, because the form I pre-registered was slightly wrong and the measurement corrected it. (1) The STING — a trailing subordinate clause promoted to a verdict, or a short closing fragment that recasts — is never permitted anywhere; it runs at 27x the reference and Morrowind essentially does not do it. (2) The EPIGRAM — a short closing sentence turning on a word already said — IS permitted, but only on a disposition-gated info and at most one per topic; measured at reference PARITY (1.16x in dialogue, 0.79x in books, i.e. they use it more), so this is a density rule and not a prohibition. (3) Everything else closes flat: the last sentence states a fact, gives a direction, names a price, or asks the player something. The refinement matters — the first form banned the epigram outright and would have driven a rewrite that made the prose worse and moved no number.
DO NOT TOUCH game/data/books/ WHILE W1-LIBRARY-MARTIAL IS WRITING. Every book file was rewritten at 16:49 mid-run, so I left the whole directory alone. Five declarative Which fragments remain there (the-arms-of-the-province.json x3, the-long-tail.json x2) plus one in foundational.json that is a deliberate chant in capitals and should stay. Those are the only ones left in the corpus.
A CHECK THAT PENALISES THE FIX IS WORSE THAN NO CHECK. Two of my metrics initially counted an interrogative — 'Which is it?', 'Which tide were you drawn on?' — as the manufactured-fragment tic, and a third counted an interrogative closing sentence as a closing sting. All three would have charged a file for asking the player a question, which is the exact defect the round exists to remove. They now exclude interrogatives by the question mark. If you add a prose metric, check which direction it pushes the next writer before you trust it.
